Name: Sales
Prompt:
- only Items with "SellItem"='Y' are considered sales item. For non selling items, consider only these items
- For Itemwise sales, consider only those invoices where DocType='I'

- Historical sales analysis should include both open and closed invoices unless explicitly requested otherwise.
- Do not filter DocStatus='O' for historical analytics.
- Exclude canceled documents using CANCELED='N'.
- Use DocStatus only when analyzing pending/open documents.

Name: Finance/Accounting
Prompt:
### SALES INVOICE SETTLEMENTS
- Internal Reconciliation (OITR & ITR1) tables are used to track the settlement of Sales Invoices
- Sales Invoices can be settled by Payments (ORCT), Credit Notes (ORIN), or Journal Entries through Internal Reconciliation (OITR & ITR1)
- OITR.ReconType : 3-Payments, 0-Manual, 4-Credit Note, 7-Cancellation
- In case of Manual Reconciliation, multiple type of documents can be used for settling each other (Any Debit entries (Invoices/Outgoing Payments/Journal Entries) against Any Credit entries (Credit Notes/Receipts/Journal Entries)
